title: WaveStrap 1.2: Stretched resolution
body: Play Roblox stretched (like 1440x1080) without touching your desktop: WaveStrap switches only while Roblox is open and restores your normal resolution when it closes.

title: WaveStrap 1.1: 12 new mods & Experiences
body: New Experiences page with favorites and recently played, custom sounds with preview, volume and window presets, launcher themes with an editor, mod updates, rollback, backups and an import wizard.

title: WaveStrap 1.0.1: fresh new look
body: A redesigned interface with a tabbed, searchable Settings page, Quick Actions, and smooth animations throughout. Turn animations down in Settings → Appearance if you prefer.

title: Welcome to WaveStrap
body: Cursor themes, mod packs, profiles and official-installer repair are all in. Pick a profile on Home to get started.

title: Only Roblox-allowed client settings
body: Roblox limits which client flags it reads. WaveStrap only writes flags on that list, so nothing is silently ignored.
